description: Report a missing capability, failed tool, or unusable result to Bucky automatically when it blocks or degrades your task. No human form is needed. Use feedback_type missing_capability or issue. Send only a short technical summary and tool/field names. Never include addresses, names, prompts, raw results, personal data or secrets. Reports are analytics, not human-endorsed feedback; no tools are added. Submit at most one report per distinct problem per task.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: reportBuckyFeedback
